source_claim: Intraday Brownian Variance Distortion: SPVD assumes stationary diffusion ATR*sqrt(t), ignoring U-shaped intraday volatility smile
evidence: SPVD multiplies constant ATR_1m by sqrt(remaining_mins). In financial time series, afternoon variance drops by ~40% between 12:00-13:30 PM.
impact_on_live_paper: Causes SPVD energy gate to overestimate afternoon moves, occasionally admitting low-volatility chop trades unless vetoed by Lunch Dead Zone.
impact_on_offline_research: Distorts synthetic energy filters in backtests.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B notes Lunch Dead Zone (11:00-13:30) already suppresses Gear 1 entries during the lowest volume period; Reviewer C notes that on trend days (Gear 2) afternoon variance actually expands.
conclusion: EMPIRICAL_HYPOTHESIS: Baseline SPVD works as an admissible boundary, but a time-decaying volume multiplier can refine accuracy.

source_claim: Arbitrary Magic Thresholds: wick_min=4.0, KER=0.35, Lunch Dead Zone=11:00-13:30 are point estimates
evidence: Fixed constants calibrated against Oct 7 historical session. May fail to generalize if structural volatility shifts.
impact_on_live_paper: Low: Produced 11 wins out of 11 trades on Oct 15 across NIFTY and SENSEX.
impact_on_offline_research: Medium: Overfitting risk across multi-month backtests.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer E confirms 0.35 KER separates directional trend days (>0.35) from mean-reverting chop (<0.35) in Indian index microstructure.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Necessary heuristic regime boundary; parameter sensitivity bounds must be tested.

source_claim: Conflation of Spot Index Points with Option Yield in target/stop definitions
evidence: Target is +15 spot pts, SL is -12 spot pts. For an option with delta ~0.65, +15 spot yields ~9.75 option pts gross, but friction eats 1.4-2.0 pts.
impact_on_live_paper: Understood in live paper advisor because resolve_real_option_quote and validate_net_yield_gate enforce positive net premium yield.
impact_on_offline_research: Severe in scripts that multiply spot points directly as option returns.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D confirms APM now tracks opt_pnl_pts and opt_entry_ltp in parallel with spot.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Underlying index is the primary signal driver; option premium accounting must be separated in reporting.

source_claim: Static Macro Exhaustion Boundary: Hardcoded 300 pts (NIFTY) or 1500 pts (SENSEX)
evidence: On Oct 15, SENSEX expanded >1290 pts, hitting the previous 1100 pt cap and vetoing valid breakout signals until calibrated to 1500 pts.
impact_on_live_paper: Caused false suppression of 12:45-13:00 breakouts on Oct 15 before manual calibration.
impact_on_offline_research: Clips right-tail returns on large trend days.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer C points out that buying breakouts past 1200 pts pays inflated IV and risks sharp mean-reversion.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DEFECT: Fixed in PR #980 by making cap dynamic per asset profile (1500 pts on SENSEX).

source_claim: Absence of Real-Time Implied Volatility (IV) Dynamics: Buying options without IV percentile filter
evidence: Option candidates are selected purely on moneyness (ITM 1 strike) and LTP without comparing IV to historical percentile.
impact_on_live_paper: Low on intraday momentum (delta gains dominate on 15m holds); High during afternoon IV crush on expiry day.
impact_on_offline_research: Leaves strategy exposed to post-event volatility contraction.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B notes real-time Black-Scholes inversion requires accurate interest rate and dividend assumptions which can introduce model risk.
conclusion: EMPIRICAL_HYPOTHESIS: IV percentile filter is a desirable diagnostic overlay but not a proven gate blocker.

source_claim: Symmetric Stop-Loss Assumption on Skewed Underlying: Identical 12 pt stop for CE and PE
evidence: Downside put moves exhibit higher velocity and wider 1m wicks than upside call grinds.
impact_on_live_paper: Low: Dynamic Vol-SL scales SL as max(initial_sl, 1.2 * ATR_1m), which automatically widens during high-velocity put drops.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D confirms Dynamic Vol-SL adapts dynamically to realized bar size.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Handled dynamically by 1.2 * ATR_1m floor.

source_claim: Fixed 1-Strike In-The-Money (ITM) Rigidity: K +- 50 (NIFTY) or K +- 100 (SENSEX)
evidence: Always picks 1 strike ITM. If spot moves rapidly between bar intervals, moneyness can drift.
impact_on_live_paper: None: 1-strike ITM provides optimal delta (~0.60-0.70) while avoiding deep ITM bid-ask illiquidity.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer C confirms 1-strike ITM has highest liquidity and tightest percentage spreads in Indian index options.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Sound institutional practice for directional option buying.

source_claim: Understated Bid-Ask Spread on Expiry Afternoons: 4.0% threshold too tight for low premium strikes
evidence: For an option trading at 15.00, a minimum tick spread of 0.75 is 5.0%, triggering VETO_SPREAD_EXPANDED.
impact_on_live_paper: Fails closed safely by preventing entry into low-dollar decaying options.
impact_on_offline_research: May artificially suppress late-day expiry trades.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer C notes that failing closed on wide relative spread protects against negative slippage.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Fail-closed spread protection is working as designed.

source_claim: Single-Quote Snapshot Slippage Illusion: Assuming fills at latest quote without order-book depth
evidence: Fills assume LTP/Bid/Ask at completed bar boundary without simulating order consumption across top 5 depth levels.
impact_on_live_paper: Zero for 1-lot retail paper tests (top of book quantity is 500-2000 qty). Significant if scaling to >50 lots.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer E agrees: Sentinel is currently scoped to 1-lot retail advisory; multi-lot depth consumption must be simulated before scaling.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Valid for 1 lot; requires depth queue simulation for multi-lot.

source_claim: Pre-Subscribed Strike Ceiling Starvation: Spot outrunning morning websocket subscription list
evidence: On Oct 15, SENSEX rallied to 74,243. The highest subscribed CE strike in capture was 73,800. Evaluated candidates triggered VETO_OPTION_QUOTE_NOT_EVALUABLE.
impact_on_live_paper: Suppressed valid potential trades during post-12:30 rally because option quotes were absent in local capture feed.
impact_on_offline_research: Truncates evaluation on extreme expansion days.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B confirms feed failed closed safely (no hallucinated trades), but subscription planning was incomplete.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DEFECT: Dynamic strike universe planning algorithm needed to replace stale strikes under 123-token cap.

source_claim: Negative Theta Bleed in Sideways Chop: 15-minute time timeout burns option value on 0-DTE
evidence: On Oct 14 chop, NIFTY PE trades held 12-15 minutes in sideways action lost 2-4 points of premium purely to time decay.
impact_on_live_paper: Observed in trade history: TRADE_1418_PE lost -2.0 prem pts while spot was flat (+1.0 pt).
reviewer_objections: Reviewer A notes 15 minutes is already a tight scalp horizon; exiting faster increases false whipsaw frequency.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Microstructure reality of 0-DTE option buying.

source_claim: Exchange Friction Asymmetry: BSE transaction charges differ from NSE
evidence: BSE FO charges, turnover fee, and STT schedule differs from NSE.
impact_on_live_paper: None: DynamicOptionSlippageModel in PR #980 was explicitly initialized with exchange="BSE" or "NSE".
reviewer_objections: Reviewer C verified PR #980 commit 337f12c48 already wired exchange="BSE" into SENSEX advisor.
conclusion: ALREADY_HANDLED: Verified in PR #980 codebase.

source_claim: Bar-Close Boundary Execution Gap: Signals evaluate at completed bar close, orders fill at T+latency
evidence: Advisor polls completed 1m candles. Fill quote resolved at bar_close_cutoff_epoch.
impact_on_live_paper: Live paper execution is conservative because it requires quote to be pre-boundary.
impact_on_offline_research: In replay backtests, fills must be tested at next-tick open to prove no lookahead.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B verifies quote cutoff is strictly <= bar_close, enforcing causal admissibility.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Replay test harness must enforce next-tick executable quote.

source_claim: Intrabar High/Low Ambiguity (First-Passage Time) in 1m bars
evidence: When curr_bar touches both TP and SL, order of occurrence is ambiguous without tick data.
impact_on_live_paper: None: Code strictly resolves `if hit_sl and hit_tp: exit_price = current_sl; exit_reason = "STOP_LOSS_HIT"`.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D verified lines 162-166 of active_position_manager.py resolve SL first.
conclusion: ALREADY_HANDLED: Strict conservative fail-closed precedence is already enforced.

source_claim: Unsynchronized Index vs FO Timestamps: Separate websockets may have sub-second skew
evidence: NSE_INDEX and NSE_FO streams are received over separate socket channels.
impact_on_live_paper: Negligible on 1-minute bar frequency (60,000 ms resolution vs <50 ms socket jitter).
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B confirms 1m bar boundaries dominate sub-second network skew.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Not material for 1-minute bars; critical only for tick scalping.

source_claim: Missing Exchange Event Time Verification in Upstox parquet feeds
evidence: Every audit row sets `exchange_event_time_verified: false` and `receive_time_verified: true`.
impact_on_live_paper: None: Receive time is the actual arrival time at the local machine, which is strictly causal for local decisions.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B confirms receive-time is strictly causal (cannot trade before local arrival).
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Explicitly labeled CAPTURE_RECEIVE_TIME_REPLAY_ONLY in all logs.

source_claim: Weekend/Holiday Expiry Shift Blindness: Day-of-week hardcoding
evidence: Day-of-week is 1 (Tuesday) for NIFTY and 3 (Thursday) for SENSEX.
impact_on_live_paper: None: core/expiry_calendar.py checks holiday pullback calendar before determining 0-DTE status.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer B verified core/expiry_calendar.py includes holiday adjustment logic.
conclusion: ALREADY_HANDLED: Handled by SentinelExpiryCalendar.

source_claim: DEF-01 Inverted Stop Loss in Walk-Forward Optimizer: high <= sl_spot instead of >=
evidence: Line 119 has hit_sl = (curr_bar["high"] <= pos["sl_spot"]). For puts, SL is above entry, so condition prematurely stops winning trades.
reproduction_command: python -c "h, sl = 22700, 22750; print('BUG hit_sl:', h <= sl, 'CORRECT hit_sl:', h >= sl)"
impact_on_live_paper: Zero: Live APM runtime in core/active_position_manager.py correctly implements `bar_high >= current_sl`.
impact_on_offline_research: Severe: Distorts parameter selection in offline optimizer.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D proved live advisor was not affected; Reviewer E confirmed optimizer fold metrics were biased.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DEFECT: Fixed in Challenger lane.

source_claim: Dual Dashboard Streamlit File-Watcher Crash when branches switch
evidence: Streamlit LocalSourcesWatcher throws FileNotFoundError if parent worktree branch is switched, hanging localhost:8502/8503.
impact_on_live_paper: Froze user UI in browser at 12:28 and 13:40.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D resolved this by running dashboards out of dedicated isolated worktrees.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DEFECT: Resolved by worktree isolation.

source_claim: WAL Recovery on Crash Leaves State in STANDBY without exit record
evidence: If process terminates with open trade, APM recovers to LIQUIDATED with CRASH_RECOVERY_FAIL_CLOSED, leaving exit_price=None.
impact_on_live_paper: Trade TRADE_1513_PE on Oct 14 has exit_price=None, PnL=None.
impact_on_offline_research: Trade cannot be evaluated without retroactive tick recovery.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D confirms fail-closed liquidation is strictly safer than assuming an exit price that was never observed.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Fails closed safely; marked NOT_EVALUABLE in audit ledger.

source_claim: No Partial-Fill State Handling in APM
evidence: APM models binary execution (all-or-nothing fill).
impact_on_live_paper: None: Retail 1-lot trading always executes completely in liquid index options.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer C confirms 1 lot of NIFTY/SENSEX has 100% fill rate at top of book.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Valid for 1 lot; required before institutional multi-lot deployment.

source_claim: Concurrent Ticker Log Collisions when running SENSEX and NIFTY simultaneously
evidence: Prior to commit ca5344509, advisor did not parse --ticker argument in __main__, defaulting SENSEX process to NIFTY log.

reviewer_objections: Reviewer D verified ca5344509 fixed CLI argument parsing and path routing.
conclusion: ALREADY_HANDLED: Fixed and verified in PR #980.

source_claim: Lack of Dynamic Re-Arming Guard: Rapid re-entry after exit in same macro wave
evidence: If a trade hits TP, next bar could immediately re-enter if conditions remain true.
impact_on_live_paper: Handled by Re-Entry Displacement Gate: requires >= max(base_disp, 1.2 * ATR_1m) progress from prior exit.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer A confirmed Displacement Veto successfully suppressed 12+ premature re-entries on Oct 15.
conclusion: ALREADY_HANDLED: Displacement gate successfully prevents overtrading.

source_claim: Multi-Hypothesis Overfitting (Data Dredging) in Parameter Grid Searches
evidence: Grid searches across parameter space select best OOS PnL without Family-Wise Error Rate adjustment.
impact_on_live_paper: Moderate: Parameters chosen may reflect sample-specific noise.

reviewer_objections: Reviewer E requires separate untouched final holdout and Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DEFECT: Fixed in Challenger test harness by reserving untouched holdout.

source_claim: Small-Sample Extrapolation (The 7-Day Trap): N=26 trades is statistically small
evidence: 26 total prospective trades across 5 active sessions. 95% confidence interval on 69% win rate spans 48% to 85%.
impact_on_live_paper: High: Cannot claim guaranteed long-term edge from 26 trades.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer E insists 7 sessions must be treated as an unverified research lead, not a commercial proof.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DESIGN_TRADEOFF: Mandates minimum 10 additional prospective sessions before capital allocation.

source_claim: Survivorship Bias in Offline Parquet Chunks: Broken chunks pruned during stitching
evidence: Stitching script prunes corrupted chunks, potentially masking live capture feed dropouts.

reviewer_objections: Reviewer B verified stitching_summary_20261014.json shows valid_chunks=392, skipped=0.
conclusion: UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM: Zero chunks were skipped in actual session summaries.

reviewer_objections: Reviewer E confirmed separate ledgers in v2 audit eliminate blending deception.
conclusion: CONFIRMED_DEFECT: Fixed by providing unblended per-index accounting.

source_claim: Absence of Synthetic Monte Carlo Permutations to establish ruin probability
evidence: No trade order shuffling or block-bootstrapping performed to test max consecutive drawdown streaks.

conclusion: EMPIRICAL_HYPOTHESIS: Added to Challenger statistical validation pipeline.

source_claim: Displacement Gate Dependency on Single Exit Bar breaks determinism if process restarts
evidence: self.last_exit_price is stored in memory. However, APM persists last_completed_trade in WAL.
impact_on_live_paper: None: On crash recovery, APM rehydrates last_completed_trade from WAL JSON file.
reviewer_objections: Reviewer D verified lines 90-99 of active_position_manager.py persist and recover last_completed_trade.
conclusion: ALREADY_HANDLED: Persisted atomically in WAL.

source_claim: Absence of Liquidity/Slippage Stress-Testing for Institutional Multi-Lot Sizing
evidence: Model applies fixed half-spread plus latency slip; does not model order-size market impact (Q / Depth).

impact_on_offline_research: Required only before institutional capital scaling.
